Frequently Asked Questions
Say goodbye to time-consuming inventory management tasks.
What is MarketMan and how does it improve restaurant profitability?
+
MarketMan is a cloud-based restaurant management platform that centralizes inventory control, purchasing, expense tracking, and recipe costing in one place. By automating back-of-house tasks, restaurants typically reduce COGS by 3–5% and reclaim hours previously lost to manual processes.
What types of restaurants use MarketMan?
+
Quick-service restaurants, full-service dining, cafes, bars, and ghost kitchens all use MarketMan to manage back-of-house operations. The platform is designed to perform for single-location operators and large multi-unit chains alike, with features that adapt to the specific needs of each business model.
How long does it take to implement MarketMan?
+
Implementation typically takes 2–4 weeks for single-location restaurants, with guided onboarding, data migration, and staff training provided by the MarketMan team from day one. The process is designed to minimize operational disruption and get teams productive as quickly as possible.
How much does MarketMan cost?
+
Tier-based pricing starts at $249/month for the Starter plan, with Growth ($299/month) and Enterprise (from $449) options available for operations with more complex needs. Visit the Pricing Page or contact the sales team for a quote tailored to your restaurant group.
Can I see a demo of MarketMan before committing?
+
A free, no-obligation demo is available with a dedicated MarketMan restaurant expert who will walk through the platform and answer questions specific to your operation. Request one directly from the MarketMan website at any time.

We work with Foodservice Manufacturers and Distributors, Restaurant Operators, Hospitality Groups, and Franchises to achieve integrated information technology that strengthens supplier and customer relationships and increases efficiency and productivity with business intelligence that drives data-driven decisions.
Our technology aims to empower distributors to optimize their supply chains, hospitality groups to curate unforgettable guest journeys, and restaurant operators to create profitable dishes that delight. Your Questions, Answered
Say goodbye to time-consuming inventory management process.
What is the mission of MarketMan?
MarketMan's mission is to empower restaurant operators with the data and tools needed to succeed in a competitive industry — simplifying back-of-house operations, increasing profitability, and freeing teams to focus on what matters most: great food and memorable guest experiences.
Who is Meal Ticket, and what is its relationship to MarketMan?
MarketMan is powered by Meal Ticket, a leader in software solutions for the foodservice industry. Meal Ticket provides the technology and data expertise that underpins the platform, supporting a shared mission to deliver data-driven results to restaurant operators worldwide.
What is the company culture like at MarketMan?
A collaborative, innovation-driven culture defines how MarketMan operates — with a team united by a passion for hospitality and technology, and a shared commitment to building tools that create measurable impact for customers worldwide.
How does MarketMan support the restaurant community?
Support for the restaurant community extends beyond software at MarketMan — through educational resources, industry partnerships, and active engagement with operator feedback. The belief is that equipping operators with the right knowledge and tools makes the entire foodservice ecosystem more sustainable and successful.
Where is MarketMan headquartered and where does it operate?
With a remote-first culture and key operational hubs in North America, Europe, and the Middle East, MarketMan serves an international customer base of over 15,000 restaurants worldwide. The distributed team model keeps MarketMan close to the markets it serves while drawing talent from across the globe.

MarketMan Privacy Policy
Last updated: November 27, 2025
This Privacy Policy explains how MarketMan Inc. and its affiliates (“ we ,” “ us ,” or “ our ”) collect, use, disclose, and protect personal data in connection with our Platform, which includes our websites ( marketman.com ) and our web and mobile applications (together, the “ Platform ”).
This Policy applies to anyone who interacts with the Platform including visitors, customers, their authorized users, vendors and job applicants.
If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, please do not use the Platform.
For information about our use of cookies, see our cookie policy at https://www.marketman.com/cookies
Information We Collect
We collect information you provide when you: create an account (e.g., name, business name, role, email address, phone number, and login credentials), request a demo, contact us, or subscribe to our mailing lists (e.g., name, company, contact details, and the content of your message) and/or apply for a job with us (e.g., contact information, CV, and related application details)
Information collected automatically: When you use or view the Platform, we may automatically collect information such as your device type, browser type, IP address, operating system, language settings, access times, and usage data (e.g., pages viewed, interactions, and referring URLs). We also use cookies and similar technologies for these purposes, as described in our cookie policy at https://www.marketman.com/cookies ‍
Information from third parties: We may receive information from analytics, marketing, or business partners, and from customers that authorize users to access the Platform (for example, when a customer creates user accounts for its team members).
How We Use Personal Data
We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
To operate and provide the Platform, including account setup and management, authentication, user management, customer support, technical functionality, and maintaining the security and integrity of the Platform.
To communicate with you – for example, to respond to inquiries, send administrative information, provide updates about the Platform, or notify you of changes to our terms or policies.
To improve and develop the Platform, including analyzing usage, monitoring performance, and enhancing user experience.
To send marketing communications, where permitted by law or based on your explicit consent upon your registration to the Platform, or if and when you subscribe for our newsletters or blogs. We may send updates, offers, or newsletters. You may opt out at any time.
To protect our rights and comply with legal obligations, including fraud prevention, enforcing our agreements, and meeting regulatory requirements.
For recruitment purposes, when you apply for a job, to process your application and communicate with you during the recruitment process.
Where required by law, we rely on legal bases such as the performance of a contract, compliance with legal obligations, our legitimate interests, or your consent (where applicable).
Finally, please note that above mentioned Personal Data may also be used to comply with applicable laws, with investigations performed by the relevant authorities, law enforcement purposes, and/or to exercise or defend legal claims. In certain cases, we may also anonymize your Personal Data. “Anonymous Information” means information which does not enable identification of an individual user, such as aggregated information about the use of our services. We may use Anonymous Information and/or disclose it to third parties without restrictions (for example, in order to improve our services and enhance your experience with them).
How We Share Personal Data
WE DO NOT SELL PERSONAL DATA .
We may share personal data in the following circumstances:
With service providers and partners who help us operate, maintain, and improve the Platform, including hosting, analytics, marketing, communication, payment, and recruitment service providers. These parties process personal data only on our behalf and under appropriate data protection agreements.
With customers (like you), where personal data is provided by you or anyone on your behalf, and processed in connection with an account or user authorized by a customer. For legal or regulatory reasons, to comply with applicable law, respond to lawful requests, enforce our agreements, protect our rights, or prevent fraud, security, or technical issues.
In a business transfer, in the event of a merger, acquisition, sale of assets, or similar corporate transaction involving all or part of our business.
With your consent, where you have provided explicit consent for such sharing or transferring your Personal Data to a third party (e.g., where you provide us with marketing consents or opt-in to optional additional services or functionality).
International Data Transfers
We may process, store, or access personal data outside the jurisdiction where it was collected.
When such transfers occur, we take appropriate steps to ensure that personal data is handled in accordance with this Privacy Policy and with applicable data protection laws, including the implementation of relevant safeguards where required.
Data Retention and Security
We retain personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including to provide our services, comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. The retention period may vary depending on the type of information and the context of its collection. When personal data is no longer required, we take reasonable steps to delete, anonymize, or securely store it in accordance with applicable law.
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures designed to protect personal data from accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorized disclosure, or access. While we make reasonable efforts to safeguard information, no system can be completely secure, and we cannot guarantee that unauthorized access or misuse will never occur.
Cookie and SDK lifetimes, as well as analytics retention periods, are described in our cookie policy at https://www.marketman.com/cookies
Your Rights and Choices
Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have certain rights regarding your personal data. These may include the right to:
Access the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
Request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal or contractual obligations.
Object to or restrict certain types of processing, including for direct marketing purposes.
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent, without affecting the lawfulness of processing prior to withdrawal.
Request data portability, where applicable.
You may exercise these rights by contacting us at [ [email protected] ]. We may ask for reasonable information to verify your identity before fulfilling your request.
If you believe your privacy rights have not been respected, or if you have concerns about our handling of your personal data, you may also have the right to contact or file a complaint with your local data protection authority.
Note for U.S. Residents
For residents of California and other U.S. states with applicable privacy laws, the rights described above, including the rights to access, correct and delete personal information, and, where applicable, to opt out of certain data uses, also apply.
Please note that we do not sell or share personal information as these terms are defined under U.S. privacy legislation.
For any privacy-related questions or requests, you can contact us at [ [email protected] ].
Children’s Privacy
Our Platform is not directed to children under the age of 18, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18. If we become aware that a child under 18 has provided us with personal data, we will take steps to delete such information.
If you believe that we might have received information from a child, please contact us at [ [email protected] ].
Third-Party Links
Our Platform may include links to third-party websites or services that are not operated or controlled by us. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or the content of such third-party sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party site you visit before providing your personal data.
Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, technologies, or legal requirements. When we do, we will revise the “Last Updated” date at the top of this page and, where required by law, provide notice or seek renewed consent for material changes. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.

MarketMan is the go-to solution for quick service restaurants, coffee shops, bars and full-service establishments looking to streamline operations.

Your Questions, Answered
Say goodbye to time-consuming inventory management processes.
What are the hardware requirements for MarketMan?
MarketMan requires no proprietary hardware — the platform runs entirely in the cloud and is fully compatible with existing Windows and Mac computers, as well as iOS and Android devices. Inventory and operations can be managed from any device, anywhere. The MarketMan mobile app is available on Google Play and the Apple App Store .
Which POS systems integrate with MarketMan?
MarketMan integrates with the industry's leading Point of Sale systems — including Square, Toast, Lightspeed, and Clover — eliminating manual data entry through seamless data synchronization. Visit the dedicated partners page for a complete list of POS integrations and the benefits of connecting your POS with MarketMan.
Does MarketMan integrate with food and beverage suppliers?
Leading food and beverage distributors — including Sysco, US Foods, Gordon Food Service, and national buying groups like GolBon and Frosty Acres — connect directly with MarketMan to automate price updates, invoice capture, and purchase order workflows. Invoices flow into the platform automatically, eliminating manual entry. Contact the sales team for the full list of integrated vendors in your region.
Is MarketMan suitable for multi-location restaurant groups?
Built to scale from a single location to national chains, MarketMan's HQ feature centralizes inventory, purchasing, and reporting across all locations from one dashboard — delivering complete operational visibility and consistency at every level of the business.
What customer support and training options does MarketMan provide?
Multi-tier support comes standard with every MarketMan plan — including a dedicated support team, customer success manager, and professional training services tailored to the subscription. From initial onboarding through advanced assistance, the team is invested in helping operators get maximum value from the platform.
